required_review.exact_information: Canonical protected test command, precollection exclusion, strict pytest/branch/100% production gate, separate Ruff/format/mypy/diff checks and confirmation authorization boundary; future pass/fail is not a witness.

required_review.relationship: Conjunctive with other members of its listed alternative; competing only where another complete alternative is explicitly listed. No independent vote or score is implied.
required_review.smaller_unit_review: Selected declarations, functions or named sections contain the governing contract. Omitted unrelated bodies are not required. Adjacent selected declarations form one coherent contract; their fields/invariants cannot honestly be dropped.

semantics.HELPFUL_ONLY: Improves efficiency, orientation or confidence but correctness is reasonably achievable from required witnesses without it.
semantics.REQUIRED: Relevant unit information is necessary within its acceptable alternative. ALL members of one alternative are required; ANY one complete alternative suffices. Resource labels project unit presence and do not require unrelated whole-file content or every competitor.
semantics.UNNECESSARY: No material additional information for this obligation given the frozen task and required contracts. Every resource cell is explicit.
semantics.UNRESOLVED: Blind evidence cannot support a defensible conclusion; never forced to unnecessary merely because evidence is missing.
semantics.unit_competition: Only listed complete alternatives independently suffice.
semantics.unit_complementarity: Members of a single alternative are conjunctive.
semantics.whole_resource_remainder: Unselected content in a required resource is unnecessary except additional directly analogous examples/operational explanation, which are helpful only; none becomes required by projection.

task_interpretation_gaps.rationale: Native provenance, competing/complementary witnesses, unresolved hypotheses, semantic non-claims, compatibility, package integration and all requested quality requirements are represented. Excluded capabilities are boundaries within the existing obligations, not silently added implementation obligations.

task_text: Implement the first production evidence-to-witness association capability for Localization, so native Retrieval and repository-role evidence can be associated with caller-authored obligation witness alternatives without treating rank, routing tier, or role support as satisfaction. The increment should preserve native evidence provenance and snapshot identity, distinguish competing alternatives from complementary witness members, expose unresolved candidate hypotheses for later resolution, integrate coherently with the existing Localization obligation kernel and routing views, add rigorous tests and architecture/development documentation, preserve package/API conventions where applicable, and pass protected development validation. Do not implement candidate elimination, numeric confidence, automatic obligation decomposition, learned ranking, Context Planning admission, or autonomous sequential acquisition.
